Start date: 1887-08-16  
Subtract 32 weeks = 32 × 7 = 224 days.  
Add 5 days → total subtract 229 days.  

1887 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Days in months before Aug 16 in 1887:  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31 → sum to 212 days.  
Aug 16 is 227 days into the year (212 + 16).  

227 − 229 = −2 days from start of year → go to previous year 1886.  
1886 is not leap (not divisible by 4), so Dec 31, 1886 is day 365.  
−2 means Dec 31 − 1 day = Dec 30, 1886.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1886-12-30
